title: CUBE Final Outcome v1
description: The orchestrator's end-to-end decision for one workflow, derived from the evidence chain and the overrides. Provisional until the workflow status is COMPLETED.

outcome.description: Default meanings in INTEGRATION-GUIDE.md. A Pod may refine its rules and must document them in docs/decisions.md.

provisional.description: true while the workflow is not COMPLETED (a stage failed, or a person must still decide).

contributing_records.description: The evidence this outcome rests on. An outcome with no evidence is a bug.
